description: Calculate a transaction's gas fee: gas units × gas price (gwei) gives the ETH cost, multiplied by the ETH price for USD. Exact BigInt math for the wei amounts. Use this when an agent needs to transaction cost in ETH and USD from gas × gwei. x402 price $0.001/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: crypto_gas_fee_calculator
title: Gas Fee Calculator
